description: Replace the raw blob://<hash>.glb text field in the Tools panel Path Asset section with a real picker (browse-from-disk and/or pick-installed-hexon) that resolves to the asset_path the PathAssetDescriptor needs, making the existing stamp-along-path pipeline discoverable and usable
wave_rationale: UI-only track with no new platform dependency for its v1 scope (pick-installed-asset path avoids quarantine contact entirely), but sequenced after the hexon-as-path-asset stamp pipeline it completes the UX for; not part of the initial parallel green wave since it is a follow-on to already-shipped work (commit 35956dd).
notes: QUARANTINE FLAG: browsing-a-NEW-glb-from-disk (FR-1a) requires content-addressed ingestion via DbCommand::ImportGltf, whose dispatch lives in fe-database/src/lib.rs (QUARANTINE) at line ~354 (handlers::crud::import_gltf_handler); fe-api/src/assets.rs (also QUARANTINE) is the read-side blob-serving surface. v1 picker is designed to avoid quarantine contact entirely by scoping to FR-1b (pick an already-installed asset/hexon from a list, mirroring hexon_manager.rs's render_installed_tab + actions/hexon.rs's set_petal_map pattern) — this needs new UI-side DTO/query plumbing (InstalledTilesetDto is terrain-tileset-shaped, not asset-shaped, per terrain_map/dto.rs:16-25) but touches no quarantined file. FR-1a (browse-new-glb) is an explicit follow-on gated on the fe-database/src/lib.rs quarantine lift. Descriptor emission path (build_descriptor -> UiAction::PathAssetApply -> SetNodeProperty -> reconcile_path_asset) is already correct and unchanged by this track. FR-4 also flags a discoverability gap: the panel doesn't name which track is the current Stamp target, only a generic Some/None hint.
